verdict: Instagram lead campaign is delivering 54 leads at $145 each — right at industry average but seasonally mistimed.
diagnosis: Spent $7,835 for 54 leads this period. Cost per lead sits near the $149 non-branded benchmark, but heating season demand is not yet reflected in creative.

recommendations.detail: LSA leads run $25–$95 in this category versus your $145. Worth piloting a small monthly budget to compare lead quality and booking rate.
